title: Agent-R1: Training Powerful LLM Agents with End-to-End Reinforcement Learning
authors_zh: Mingyue Cheng、Jie Ouyang、Shuo Yu、Ruiran Yan、Yucong Luo、Zirui Liu、Daoyu Wang、Qi Liu、Enhong Chen
paper_type_zh: 多轮工具智能体强化学习、轨迹掩码归因与版本漂移审计
best_for_zh: 关注智能体轨迹、工具环境、程序化奖励、token 掩码、检索可复现性和论文到代码版本漂移的研究者与工程人员
one_line: Agent-R1 discloses a tool-environment RL framework and a v1 Multi-hop QA reward contract across PPO/GRPO/REINFORCE++/RLOO, but no immutable v1 train split, environment/corpus snapshot, rollout/reward ledger or provenance-complete checkpoint package was verified.
Agent-R1 v1 披露了工具环境 RL 框架，以及覆盖 PPO/GRPO/REINFORCE++/RLOO 的多跳问答奖励契约；未核验到不可变 v1 训练切分、环境/语料快照、rollout/奖励账本或溯源完整的检查点包。
why: It makes the environment transition boundary and token-mask credit assignment explicit for agentic RL, yet shows why an open framework and named benchmark mixture do not establish replayable trajectories, data rights, verifier decisions or reproducible policy lineage.
inclusion_reason: A technical report and framework that makes tool-environment step transitions, masks and programmatic final feedback explicit for multi-turn agent RL, while its paper-to-code evolution highlights the need to separate framework claims from versioned data, environment and trajectory disclosure.

title: Problem
问题
html: Agent-R1 is curated as the 2025 arXiv v1 report, not as the substantially revised 2026 project report. V1 states that Multi-hop QA training has 51,200 samples drawn equally and randomly from HotpotQA and 2WikiMultihopQA training splits; it evaluates full HotpotQA/2Wiki development sets and out-of-domain MuSiQue. This is a reported mixture rather than an immutable Agent-R1 data release. V1 policy rollouts produce multi-turn natural-language reasoning and tool actions. NousToolEnv executes actions, returns feedback, calculates reward and packages next state for replay. A trace can include prompt, observation, action, reasoning, tool call and feedback, environment state, reward, termination flag, next observation, action mask, advantage mask and trajectory. The paper-run queries/results, traces, rewards, masks and rollout-to-update links are not released.

Agent-R1 在本卡中指 2025 年 arXiv v1 报告，而不是 2026 年大幅修订的项目技术报告。v1 称多跳问答训练有 51,200 个样本，等量且随机地来自 HotpotQA 和 2WikiMultihopQA 训练切分；它评估完整的 HotpotQA/2Wiki 开发集及分布外 MuSiQue。这是报告中的混合，而不是不可变的 Agent-R1 数据发布。v1 的策略 rollout 产生多轮自然语言推理和工具动作。NousToolEnv 执行动作、返回反馈、计算奖励并为 replay 打包下一状态。轨迹可包含提示、观察、动作、推理、工具调用与反馈、环境状态、奖励、终止标志、下一观察、动作掩码、优势掩码和轨迹。论文运行的查询/结果、轨迹、奖励、掩码和 rollout 到更新的关联均未发布。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html: The v1 verification contract is programmatic sparse final feedback. It combines exact-match answer correctness with a format score. The format score averages binary indicators for correct answer presentation and valid tool-call syntax. When the format score equals one, reward is exact match between predicted and gold answer; otherwise reward is the format score minus one. ToolEnv may also support environment-defined intermediate process rewards, but no canonical cross-task reward implementation, decision log or v1 verifier snapshot is released. Its stop method can terminate for LLM output, task completion, errors or predefined limits; exact paper-run stop reasons and turn limits remain unknown.

v1 的验证契约是程序化的稀疏最终反馈。它结合精确匹配的答案正确性和格式分数。格式分数对“正确答案呈现”和“有效工具调用语法”两个二元指标取平均。格式分数等于一时，奖励是预测答案与金标准的 exact match；否则奖励是格式分数减一。ToolEnv 还可以支持环境定义的中间过程奖励，但没有发布规范的跨任务奖励实现、判定日志或 v1 验证器快照。其 stop 方法可因 LLM 输出、任务完成、错误或预定义限制终止；论文运行的精确终止原因和轮数限制仍为 unknown。

title: Method
方法
html: V1 uses Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct with native function calling. The Multi-hop QA environment is NousToolEnv with one wikisearch tool over a KILT Wikipedia corpus described as 36 million passages, using bge-large-en-v1.5 embeddings and returning top five documents. Tool is an atomic executor; ToolEnv orchestrates RL state, reward and next state. V1 evaluates PPO, GRPO, REINFORCE++, REINFORCE++Baseline and RLOO, using action/loss masks and PPO advantage masks so policy updates select agent-generated rather than environment tokens. The report gives no sampling seed, record IDs, prompt templates, rollout count, inference settings, top-five retrieval logs, retained/rejected trace ledger or run-time context snapshot. Current documentation may describe append/truncate/summarize/rewrite/augment context operations, but those are later framework capabilities and are not attributed to the v1 run.

v1 使用具备原生 function calling 的 Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct。多跳问答环境为 NousToolEnv，含一个 wikisearch 工具，检索描述为 3,600 万段落的 KILT Wikipedia 语料，使用 bge-large-en-v1.5 embedding 并返回前五个文档。Tool 是原子执行器；ToolEnv 协调 RL 状态、奖励和下一状态。v1 评估 PPO、GRPO、REINFORCE++、REINFORCE++Baseline 和 RLOO，并使用动作/损失掩码及 PPO 优势掩码，使策略更新选择智能体生成 token 而不是环境 token。报告没有给出采样 seed、记录标识、提示模板、rollout 数、推理设置、前五检索日志、保留/拒绝轨迹账本或运行时上下文快照。当前文档可描述 append/truncate/summarize/rewrite/augment 等上下文操作，但它们是后续框架能力，不能归因于 v1 运行。

title: Evidence
证据
html: The evidence bundle verifies arXiv v1 submitted on 2025-11-18, the current official repository, its official legacy branch and MIT licenses. The current arXiv v2 from 2026-05-30 changes the title, authors and content, and the current repository describes a v0.1 step-level refactor while placing previous implementation in legacy. This is version-boundary evidence only. It does not alter the v1 identity, base model, task mixture, environment, reward or algorithms recorded in this Card. Although the current repository names later tasks and recipes and says processed data was released in 2026, no immutable, rights-cleared correspondence to the 2025 v1 mixture, retrieval snapshot, traces, rewards or checkpoints is verified.

证据账本已核验 2025-11-18 提交的 arXiv v1、当前官方仓库、其官方 legacy 分支和 MIT 许可证。2026-05-30 的当前 arXiv v2 改变了标题、作者和内容，当前仓库也描述 v0.1 的 step-level 重构，并将以前实现置于 legacy。这仅是版本边界证据；它不会改变本卡中记录的 v1 身份、基础模型、任务混合、环境、奖励或算法。尽管当前仓库命名了后续任务和配方，并称 2026 年发布了 processed data，但尚未核验到它与 2025 v1 混合、检索快照、轨迹、奖励或检查点之间不可变且权利清晰的对应关系。

title: Novelty
新意
html: For this atlas, the distinctive contribution is an explicit tool-environment transition and masking contract for multi-turn agent RL. V1 separates atomic tool execution from ToolEnv state/reward/next-state management, and makes action/loss and advantage masks central to credit assignment. It therefore enables comparison of agent-generated versus environment token boundaries alongside final-answer feedback. The card also captures a critical disclosure lesson: framework evolution must be version-bound. Current GSPO/StepPO, GAE/token-GAE, GiGPO, Qwen3-4B, ALFWorld, WebShop, Paper Search and step-level AgentEnv claims are later repository facts, not v1 evidence.

对本图谱而言，其区别性贡献是为多轮智能体 RL 明确给出工具环境转移与掩码归因契约。v1 将原子工具执行与 ToolEnv 的状态/奖励/下一状态管理分开，并把动作/损失掩码和优势掩码置于归因中心。因此，它支持比较智能体生成 token 与环境 token 的边界以及最终答案反馈。本卡还记录了一项关键披露经验：框架演化必须受版本约束。当前仓库的 GSPO/StepPO、GAE/token-GAE、GiGPO、Qwen3-4B、ALFWorld、WebShop、Paper Search 和 step-level AgentEnv 都是后续事实，不是 v1 证据。

title: Limitations
局限
html: Exact match plus format can reward presentation and tool syntax without establishing factual grounding, correct retrieval, citation support or robust multi-hop reasoning. Tool feedback may be stochastic or time-varying; no versioned KILT snapshot, retrieved-document log or environment-state record makes v1 rollouts replay-auditable. V1 action and advantage masks are unexposed, preventing independent credit-assignment audit. Source rows, source revisions/licenses, the 50/50 sampling seed, preprocessing, prompt templates, train/dev map, KILT passage snapshot, query results, stop records, policy/optimizer versions and checkpoint lineage are unknown. The MIT code license does not establish rights for benchmarks, Wikipedia/KILT, embeddings, tool outputs or generated traces. Later v2/current-repository changes cannot fill v1 gaps without a verified record-level correspondence.

exact match 加格式奖励可能激励答案呈现和工具语法，却不能建立事实依据、正确检索、引用支持或稳健的多跳推理。工具反馈可能随机或随时间变化；没有版本化 KILT 快照、检索文档日志或环境状态记录，v1 rollout 不能被回放审计。v1 的动作和优势掩码未公开，无法独立审计归因。来源行、来源修订/许可证、50/50 采样 seed、预处理、提示模板、训练/开发映射、KILT 段落快照、查询结果、终止记录、策略/优化器版本和检查点血缘均为 unknown。MIT 代码许可证不能建立基准、Wikipedia/KILT、embedding、工具输出或生成轨迹的权利。没有经核验的记录级对应关系，后来的 v2/当前仓库变化不能填补 v1 缺口。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: Evidence-backed uses are RLVR, agent training and evaluation at the v1 framework and reward-contract level. The Card supports comparison of multi-turn ToolEnv state transitions, final exact-match/format feedback, tool-augmented traces and mask-based credit assignment. It does not establish that the 51,200 examples, KILT corpus, retrieved documents, tool calls, traces, masks, rewards or checkpoint lineage are reusable or reproducible. A v1 reuse decision requires immutable source and retrieval manifests, rights, split and contamination evidence, verifier and stop contracts, paper-run trace/mask/reward logs, version-pinned dependencies and checkpoints.

有证据支持的用途是在 v1 框架和奖励契约层面进行 RLVR、智能体训练和评估。本卡支持比较多轮 ToolEnv 状态转移、最终 exact match/格式反馈、工具增强轨迹和基于掩码的归因。它不能证明 51,200 个示例、KILT 语料、检索文档、工具调用、轨迹、掩码、奖励或检查点血缘可被复用或复现。v1 复用决策需要不可变来源与检索清单、权利、切分与污染证据、验证器和终止契约、论文运行轨迹/掩码/奖励日志、固定版本依赖和检查点。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
• Version boundary to inspect: retain arXiv v1 and its Qwen2.5-3B Multi-hop QA experiment; do not project v2/current-repository recipes back onto it.
  • Trace unit to verify: observation/context, action/reasoning/tool call, feedback, reward, next observation, termination and action/advantage masks.
  • Feedback contract to verify: final exact match only when both answer presentation and tool-call syntax format indicators pass; otherwise format score minus one.
  • Reuse gate before relying on v1: source/retrieval/split manifests, queries and top-five results, trace/mask/reward/stop logs, verifier definitions, rights and version-pinned reproduction assets.

• 应核查的版本边界：保留 arXiv v1 及其 Qwen2.5-3B 多跳问答实验；不要把 v2/当前仓库配方投射回去。
  • 应核查的轨迹单元：观察/上下文、动作/推理/工具调用、反馈、奖励、下一观察、终止和动作/优势掩码。
  • 应核查的反馈契约：只有答案呈现和工具调用语法指标都通过时才使用最终 exact match；否则使用格式分数减一。
  • 依赖 v1 前的复用门槛：来源/检索/切分清单、查询和前五结果、轨迹/掩码/奖励/终止日志、验证器定义、权利和固定版本的复现资产。

items: Exact-match plus format reward can reward answer formatting/tool syntax while failing to establish factual grounding, correct retrieval, citation support or robust multi-hop reasoning.
Tool/environment feedback can be stochastic or time-varying; without a versioned KILT snapshot, retrieved-document logs and environment states, the reported agent rollouts are not replay-auditable.
Action and advantage masks are central to the reported v1 optimization but paper-run token/mask records are unavailable, preventing an independent audit of credit assignment.
